name: fig-brush
description: Turn a scientific plot screenshot into reusable Origin format parameters and an optional graph template.

interface.shortDescription: Extract reusable Origin styling from a reference image.
interface.longDescription: Give fig-brush one PNG or JPEG reference. It writes a one-page APPLY_FORMAT.md guide plus a compact, reviewable format_parameters.json and reference_analysis.json. With Origin already open, apply_active_format can paste the visual bundle into the active graph without a script; a native reference .opju can be staged for Origin's built-in right-click Paste Format. If the user already has an Origin .opju, apply-format creates a styled copy without overwriting the source; an .otpu template remains optional. It never requires or includes the user's research data.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze this scientific plot reference and create reusable Origin format parameters. Generate APPLY_FORMAT.md, then prefer applying the bundle to the user's already open Origin graph through apply_active_format when requested. If a native reference .opju is provided, stage its native format clipboard so the user can use Origin's right-click Paste Format. Keep placeholder data out of the deliverable.
